title: Secure Social Login with Auto-Provisioning
description: As a Guest User, I want to sign in using my existing Google or Apple account so that I can securely access my personal data without creating a new password, while the system automatically provisions my profile.
business_value: Reduces registration friction increasing conversion by ~20%; secures user PII via trusted providers (Auth0); enables role-based access control (Free vs Premium) essential for monetization.
acceptance_criteria: [{"scenario":"Successful Google Sign-In on Mobile","given":"The user is on the login screen and has a valid Google account","when":"The user taps 'Sign in with Google' and authorizes the application","then":"The mobile app receives an ID token, exchanges it with the backend for a session JWT, stores the JWT securely in Keychain/Keystore, and redirects to the Dashboard."},{"scenario":"Automatic User Provisioning","given":"A new user authenticates via Auth0 for the first time","when":"The backend validates the Auth0 token","then":"A new User record is created in the PostgreSQL database with the 'Free User' role, and the user's ID is returned in the session claims."},{"scenario":"Token Refresh Failure","given":"The user's access token has expired","when":"The app attempts to refresh the token but the user has revoked access","then":"The refresh fails with a 401/403 error, the local storage is cleared, and the user is redirected to the Login screen."}]
technical_tasks: ["WI-AUTH-001: Mobile: Implement Social Login & Secure Storage","WI-AUTH-002: Backend: Identity & Role Management"]
definition_of_done: ["Google and Apple login flows functional on iOS and Android simulators","JWT and Refresh Tokens stored in secure storage (not shared preferences)","Backend middleware successfully parses claims and enforces authorization policies","Unit tests for claim parsing pass with >80% coverage"]

title: Seamless Offline Data Synchronization
description: As a Mobile User, I want my reading progress and library updates to be saved locally when I am offline and automatically synced to the server when I reconnect, so that I never lose data due to poor connectivity.
business_value: Ensures perceived reliability and data integrity; creates a 'Zero Latency' user experience by decoupling UI interactions from network calls.
acceptance_criteria: [{"scenario":"Queue Offline Mutation","given":"The device has no internet connection","when":"The user updates a reading session (e.g., page 50 to 100)","then":"The update is saved to Isar DB locally, and a 'Pending Sync' job is added to the local mutation queue."},{"scenario":"Auto-Sync on Reconnect","given":"Items exist in the local mutation queue","when":"The device regains network connectivity","then":"The background worker processes the queue, sends batched requests to the backend, and updates the local sync status upon success."},{"scenario":"Conflict Resolution (Last Write Wins)","given":"The backend has a record updated at T1","when":"The client pushes an update with timestamp T2 where T2 > T1","then":"The backend accepts the update. If T2 < T1, the backend rejects the update and returns the latest server state."}]
technical_tasks: ["WI-SYNC-001: Mobile: Implement Offline Mutation Queue","WI-SYNC-002: Backend: Implement Sync Endpoints"]
definition_of_done: ["Offline mutations persist across app restarts","Sync worker triggers automatically via connectivity_plus events","Backend handles batched sync requests transactionally","Integration tests simulate network toggling successfully"]

title: Library Search and Management
description: As a Reader, I want to search for books by title or author and add them to my personal library shelves, so that I can organize my reading backlog and track current progress.
business_value: Core functionality enabling the primary use case of the application; integration with Google Books provides a rich, zero-effort data population for users.
acceptance_criteria: [{"scenario":"Search Books via API","given":"The user is on the Library screen","when":"The user enters a book title in the search bar","then":"The app displays a list of results fetched from the Google Books API proxy, showing covers, titles, and authors."},{"scenario":"Add Book to Shelf","given":"The user has selected a book from search results","when":"The user taps 'Add to Want to Read'","then":"The book is saved to the local Isar database, displayed in the 'Want to Read' tab, and queued for sync."},{"scenario":"Filter Local Library","given":"The user has books in multiple statuses (Reading, Finished)","when":"The user selects the 'Finished' filter tab","then":"The list updates instantly to show only finished books using local data without a network call."}]
technical_tasks: ["WI-FEAT-001: Mobile: Library UI & State","WI-FEAT-002: Backend: Library Search Integration (Google Books)"]
definition_of_done: ["Book search uses backend proxy (API Key not exposed on client)","Library list uses efficient lazy loading (ListView.builder)","Local filtering is instantaneous","Unit tests cover DTO mapping from Google Books to internal domain"]

title: Personalized AI Book Recommendations
description: As a Premium User, I want to receive book recommendations based on my reading history and goals, utilizing AI analysis, so that I can discover relevant content without manual searching.
business_value: Key differentiator for the Premium tier; increases user retention by continuously providing value through personalized discovery.
acceptance_criteria: [{"scenario":"Generate Recommendations","given":"The user has a populated reading history and is a Premium subscriber","when":"The user requests recommendations","then":"The backend orchestrator retrieves user context from OpenSearch, queries OpenAI GPT-4, and returns a structured list of suggested books."},{"scenario":"Background Embedding Update","given":"The user has added new books to their library","when":"The scheduled Hangfire job runs","then":"The new reading data is embedded into vectors and upserted to the OpenSearch index."},{"scenario":"AI Service Timeout","given":"The OpenAI API is experiencing high latency","when":"The recommendation request exceeds 5 seconds","then":"The Circuit Breaker opens, and the system returns a fallback list of popular books instead of an error."}]
technical_tasks: ["WI-AI-001: Backend: User Context Embedding Job","WI-AI-002: Backend: Recommendation Orchestrator"]
definition_of_done: ["RAG pipeline successfully retrieves context from OpenSearch","OpenAI prompts are protected against injection","Circuit breaker policies are configured for external API calls","Premium role check is enforced before execution"]

title: Cloud Infrastructure Provisioning
description: As a System Owner, I want the application infrastructure to be defined as code and automatically deployable, so that the system is scalable, secure, and recoverable.
business_value: Reduces operational risk; enables auto-scaling to handle user load; ensures security compliance via private subnets and encryption.
